ارتهنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَهَنَا (irtahanā) /ir.ta.ha.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اِرْتَهَنَّا (irtahannā) /ir.ta.han.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اُرْتُهِنَا (urtuhinā) /ur.tu.hi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اُرْتُهِنَّا (urtuhinnā) /ur.tu.hin.naː/: first-person plural pas
